scope: Operational self-model, persistent human-associated objects and one bounded background web-research workflow. No automatic visual identity, image matching, reconstruction, physical promotion or model-weight training.
selfModel: Java returns actual registered host tool definitions, recent execution receipts, model discovery, selected object and durable research state. Network allowed is distinct from a successful dated external fetch. Every planning request receives a compact current summary; source text cannot register tools.
objectIdentity: New UUID per explicit human association. Repeating the same source binding reuses its object; new runs require explicit association with an existing object. World/body IDs link evidence, not proof of physical identity. Labels/categories are human guidance. Camera pixels remain private and never enter search queries.
research: Java owns frozen category/query/source binding, job progress, lease generation, interruption, cancellation and cache verification. Host owns a separate unprivileged browser worker. One worker, at most two search providers, three source pages, 12000text characters/page, 12image references/page, 120seconds/attempt. Images are reference URLs, not computed visual matches. Sources are evidence/hypotheses, not authority or measured physical properties.
acceptance: Actual local-model call reads current capability/self state; unknown/unregistered capability not invented and offline mode is accurately reported.
Same object ID survives restart and retains exact observation hashes, human label provenance, actual cached web sources and failed attempts.
Controlled browser fixtures verify selection, concurrent observation/research, background isolation, cancellation/stale lease refusal, restart recovery and corrupt-cache rejection.

A separate actual external search/source run must record real final URLs, source text hashes and reference-image URLs when present. Blocked search is retained as failure; provided-URL ingestion cannot be called a successful search.
A report verifies exact object/job/source identities and citations. No native world state, former camera tracking source, historical release or language-model weights changes.
legacy: Edition038 displacement and uncertainty remain unvalidated. Preserve all raw private recordings and README001-038. New app development uses an isolated worktree/project; existing review remains untouched.
